Extract topology of a brep

**Panel:** Comma → Surface · **Nickname:** `Topology`

## Inputs

| Name | Nickname | Type | Access | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Brep | `B` | Brep | Item |  | Base Brep |

## Outputs

| Name | Nickname | Type | Access | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Vertices | `V` | Point | List | Vertices of brep |
| Outer Loops | `OL` | Integer | Tree | Outer loops of brep |
| Inner Loops | `IL` | Integer | Tree | Inner loops of brep |
| Has Holes | `HL` | Boolean | List | Flag of holes on outer loops |
